systems.system: Register of persons under the National Registration Act
systems.platform: paper forms forwarded by registrars to the Chief Registrar
systems.tiers: registrars in specified areas take the application and photograph and forward the form to the Chief Registrar, who keeps the register

note: The 1964 Act and its regulations govern registration of persons aged 16 and over and the national registration card; they are an identity statute and say nothing of registering births or deaths beyond the surrender of a dead person's card.
